note_en: The particle 过 after a verb marks experience: 去过 means "have been," and 没去过 / 从没去过 "have never been." In the text: 一个从没去过的城市 "a city I had never been to"; 自己还从来没有一个人在陌生的城市吃过饭 "I had never once eaten alone in an unfamiliar city." 过 is about the experience itself, not when it happened, and it's negated with 没(有), not 不.
